Class SysMLEnumeration<E extends SysMLEnumeration<E>>

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.common.SysMLAnything
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLAttributeType
sysmlinjava.attributetypes.SysMLEnumeration<E>
Type Parameters:
E - The class that is extending SysMLEnumeration, i.e. the class containing the enumeration values
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<E>, ObservableAttribute
public abstract class SysMLEnumeration<E extends SysMLEnumeration<E>> extends SysMLAttributeType implements Comparable<E>
SysMLinJava representation of the SysML enumeration attribute type. In SysML, the common "enum" is the SysML Enumeration, which is an extension of the SysML Attribute type. This SysMLinJava adaptation enables the enumeration attribute type to be used in the SysMLinJava model as an observable parameter in constraintBlocks and it enables use by the many SysML tools for document auto-generation, graphical displays, etc.

Specializations of the SysMLEnumeration can be quickly and easily generated by invocation of the provided sourceCodeString() method. The sourceCodeString() method generates the source code for a specialization of the SysMLEnumeration for a specified set of enumerated values. Calling this method with the specified parameters enables quick development of the enumerated value type for SysMLinJava models.

As an abstract class, enumeration value types must be declared as extensions to this class. The generic parameter is the extension class itself, just as it is declared (by the compiler) for the Java enum type. Each of the enumerated values are then declared as static fields within the class and initialized in accordance with the constructor declared for the class. An example enumerated value type is as follows: 

public class CardinalDirectionsEnum extends SysMLEnumeration<CardinalDirectionsEnum>
{
        @EnumValue
        public static final CardinalDirectionsEnum north = new CardinalDirectionsEnum("north", 0, new DirectionRadians(0));
        @EnumValue
        public static final CardinalDirectionsEnum east = new CardinalDirectionsEnum("east", 1, new DirectionRadians(PI / 2));
        @EnumValue
        public static final CardinalDirectionsEnum south = new CardinalDirectionsEnum("south", 2, new DirectionRadians(PI));
        @EnumValue
        public static final CardinalDirectionsEnum west = new CardinalDirectionsEnum("west", 3, new DirectionRadians(PI * 1.5));

        public static final CardinalDirectionsEnum[] values = {north, east, south, west};

        public DirectionRadians direction;

        private CardinalDirectionsEnum(String name, int ordinal, DirectionRadians direction)
        {
                super(name, ordinal);
                this.direction = direction;
        }

        public static CardinalDirectionsEnum valueOf(String name)
        {
                return SysMLEnumeration.valueOf(name, values);
        }

        public static CardinalDirectionsEnum valueOf(int ordinal)
        {
                return SysMLEnumeration.valueOf(ordinal, values);
        }

        public static CardinalDirectionsEnum[] values()
        {
                return values;
        }
}

    • createUnits

      public void createUnits()
      Description copied from class: SysMLAttributeType
      Required operation to create/assign the units attribute for this attribute type. The units variable should be assigned with the name of a SysMLUnit instance located in an extension of the SysMLUnits class. An example is as follows: 
      @Override
protected void createUnits()
{
        units = SysMLinJavaUnits.FeetCubic;
}
